An Otter alternative for Turkish and 38 other languages

Check the language list first: Otter’s help center names English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese as its supported languages, and Turkish isn’t among them (as of October 18, 2026). Last updated: October 19, 2026

Which languages does Otter support?

Otter’s help center article Supported languages names English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese; a second article marks German as beta. Otter last updated the list on October 15, 2026, and we checked it on October 18, 2026. Language lists change, so look at Otter’s page for the current state before you decide.

What does Verbi offer for meetings in other languages?

  • Transcription in 39 languages with automatic language detection, among them English, Turkish, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese.
  • Recordings transcribed from start to finish, with no length limit on Pro (60 minutes a month on the free plan), and Live Transcription while people speak.
  • Speaker detection with names (Pro), so you can see who said what.
  • Summaries from nine templates, such as General Meeting, 1:1 Meeting and Action Items. They contain only what was said; owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them. Choosing a template is part of Pro; on the free plan, your first transcript gets one summary automatically.
  • Chat with the transcript and translation (both Pro), and Custom Vocabulary for names and acronyms.
  • Import audio files, share audio from other apps or paste a video link; copy the text, or with Pro export it as TXT or PDF.

Otter details come from its help center and store listings, checked on October 18, 2026. Verbi records through the phone’s microphone and doesn’t join video calls as a bot; recordings and transcripts are stored on the phone, and the privacy policy lists what is sent for transcription.

When might Otter be the right fit?

If your meetings are in English or another language on Otter’s list, and you want to work with recordings in a browser or on a Mac or Windows computer, Otter may suit your workflow. Verbi is a phone app for iPhone and Android only; it has no web or desktop version.

If your meetings, lectures or interviews are in Turkish, Arabic or another language outside Otter’s list, try Verbi on a real recording with the free plan. The guides to AI meeting notes and interview transcription walk through the steps.

Frequently asked questions

Does Otter support Turkish?

Turkish isn’t in the supported-languages list in Otter’s help center (as of October 18, 2026). The list names English, Spanish, French, German (marked beta), Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

Does Verbi join video calls as a bot?

No. Verbi records through your phone’s microphone, so nothing joins your call. For an online meeting, keep the phone near your speaker.

Can Verbi transcribe a recording I already have?

Yes. Tap Upload File in Verbi and pick the file, or share it to Verbi from the app it’s in. Imported files count toward the same monthly minutes.

Is Verbi free?

Verbi is free to download. The free plan includes 60 minutes of transcription a month, recordings kept for 15 days and your first AI summary. Verbi Pro is an optional subscription; the app shows the price before you subscribe.
